name: submit_shelf
description: Save one shelf of For You. Call it once per shelf, as soon as that shelf is ready: the user watches the shelves come in (2 of 5). The server checks every title: it must exist on TMDB under the title and year you give, and not be watched, started, rated, hidden or dropped on Trakt, or turned down; the result lists what it dropped and why. A shelf left with fewer than 6 titles isn't saved. Submitting a slug again replaces that shelf, dropped titles and all: use it to replace them. At most 6 shelves.

slug.description: A short id for the shelf, lowercase with hyphens (because-severance, new-this-month). Submitting the same slug again replaces the shelf.

kind.description: because: titles that share what the user loved in one title, named in the heading; new: released, or back with a new season, in the last few weeks; anime; gems: lesser-known titles with strong ratings; coming_soon: premieres in the next few months; other: any other theme.

title.description: The shelf's heading, at most 60 characters: Because you loved Severance, New this month for you.

subtitle.description: One short line under the heading, or empty for none.

title.description: The title as TMDB names it: the server checks the id against it.

year.description: Its release (or first air) year, as TMDB has it: the server checks the id against it too. 0 when unsure.

reason.description: Why this user will like it, in one line of at most 140 characters, grounded in their profile (a title they loved, a creator, a theme, a habit). No spoilers, no generic praise.
